research_direction: Multi-seed replication of the baseline 2x2, which the task design requires of the wrap-up winner and which no submission on this task has yet reported. The same arm (explanatory corpus at 15% dose, midtrain LR 2e-5) retrained end to end at three TrainConfig seeds, with corpora, budgets, update counts, stage templates and eval identical. The point is to measure the quantity every single-seed submission on this task leaves unestimated: how much of a reported interaction is training-seed noise. The submitted 2x2 is the FIRST replication seed (20260805), chosen by seed order and not by outcome; all three arms' numbers are reported.

cells.R: clean Dolmino midtrain -> clean Dolci SFT (reference; a real trained cell)
cells.M: live-mix midtrain (Corvane explanatory docs) -> clean Dolci SFT
cells.S: clean Dolmino midtrain -> mixed SFT (Dolci + planted software-domain rows)
